## **Full-Service Custom Aluminum Extrusions**

*1850-Ton Fully Automated 7" Extrusion Press*

### **Full-Service Extrusion Capabilities**

#### **Extrusions, Inc. is a full-service aluminum extruder featuring a large inventory of stock
#### dies and thousands of custom shapes for all types of aluminum products.****  **

Extrusions has two extrusions presses, a fabrication department, three CNC machines, a state of the
art powder coat paint line, pour and debridge machinery, polyamide strut insertion machinery, and in
house anodizing.  Our vertical integration allows us to produce the finest quality aluminum
extrusions with competitive lead times. 

Centrally located in Fort Scott, KS, Extrusions offers all the services of a larger extruder, but
hasn’t lost the ability to treat customers like a small business.  With more than 120,000 square
feet of production space and over 100 employees Extrusions can accommodate high volume orders or the
one-time order.  You can rely on Extrusions’ experienced and dedicated employees to meet your need
for aluminum extrusions. 

Since 1962 flexibility and creativity has made Extrusions, Inc a service oriented company.  Meeting
customers’ unique needs has been our #1 priority and has been responsible for our consistent growth
and success. 

Unlike some of our competitors, all the services we offer are located in our facility which allows
us to oversee and handle your products from start to finish in house.  Having a vertically
integrated business model allows us to provide exceptional customer service, better responsiveness,
excellent products, and safe shipping.

Combine this with our press capacity, finishing services, fabrication department, thermal
improvement options, and CNC capabilities and our customers have a turnkey production resource to
help your business with all your aluminum extrusions needs. 

[ Learn More ][32]

### **Sustainability**

Extrusions, Inc. is dedicated to operating its facility as environmentally friendly as possible.  To
learn more follow this link to Extrusions Inc.’s [LEED Statement][33].

Custom Aluminum Extrusions

Aluminum Fabrication

Aluminum Finishing Services

**Who We Are**

When it comes to custom aluminum extrusions, if it can be imagined, then it’s something we can bring
to life.  We understand there are going to be times when flexibility, innovation, and real person to
person access and interaction is a necessity.  That’s why we make it our priority to work closely
with clients to offer collaborative and inventive problem solving solutions for your projects.  Our
team at Extrusions, Inc., with over 100 years of combined industry experience, are your custom
design specialists.

Our biggest asset is our people that add a personal element to all our interactions.  From first
contact to shipment, it’s the sense that our people genuinely care about your business needs.  This
has led to life-long customers who come back again and again.  You can relax knowing that your
business is in the hands of an experienced team of people who care about your product. 

## **Contact us today and discover how we can help you with your extrusion, fabrication, and
## finishing needs from start to finish.**

[ Give Us A Call ][34]

## 
## **Get a Quote**

**When you need a simple shape, a complex hollow or a highly customized profile, Extrusions, Inc.,
can extrude it. **

**We have nearly 60 years of experience providing extruded aluminum to markets across the Midwest
and the United States. We look forward to helping you!**

## **Full-Service Custom Aluminum Extrusions**

*1850-Ton Fully Automated 7" Extrusion Press*

### **Full-Service Extrusion Capabilities**

#### **Extrusions, Inc. is a full-service aluminum extruder featuring a large inventory of stock
#### dies and thousands of custom shapes for all types of aluminum products.****  **

Extrusions has two extrusions presses, a fabrication department, three CNC machines, a state of the
art powder coat paint line, pour and debridge machinery, polyamide strut insertion machinery, and in
house anodizing.  Our vertical integration allows us to produce the finest quality aluminum
extrusions with competitive lead times. 

Centrally located in Fort Scott, KS, Extrusions offers all the services of a larger extruder, but
hasn’t lost the ability to treat customers like a small business.  With more than 120,000 square
feet of production space and over 100 employees Extrusions can accommodate high volume orders or the
one-time order.  You can rely on Extrusions’ experienced and dedicated employees to meet your need
for aluminum extrusions. 

Since 1962 flexibility and creativity has made Extrusions, Inc a service oriented company.  Meeting
customers’ unique needs has been our #1 priority and has been responsible for our consistent growth
and success. 

Unlike some of our competitors, all the services we offer are located in our facility which allows
us to oversee and handle your products from start to finish in house.  Having a vertically
integrated business model allows us to provide exceptional customer service, better responsiveness,
excellent products, and safe shipping.

Combine this with our press capacity, finishing services, fabrication department, thermal
improvement options, and CNC capabilities and our customers have a turnkey production resource to
help your business with all your aluminum extrusions needs. 

[ Learn More ][32]

### **Sustainability**

Extrusions, Inc. is dedicated to operating its facility as environmentally friendly as possible.  To
learn more follow this link to Extrusions Inc.’s [LEED Statement][33].

When it comes to custom aluminum extrusions, if it can be imagined, then it’s something we can bring
to life.  We understand there are going to be times when flexibility, innovation, and real person to
person access and interaction is a necessity.  That’s why we make it our priority to work closely
with clients to offer collaborative and inventive problem solving solutions for your projects.  Our
team at Extrusions, Inc., with over 100 years of combined industry experience, are your custom
design specialists.

Our biggest asset is our people that add a personal element to all our interactions.  From first
contact to shipment, it’s the sense that our people genuinely care about your business needs.  This
has led to life-long customers who come back again and again.  You can relax knowing that your
business is in the hands of an experienced team of people who care about your product.

## What We Do

Aircraft Extrusion Company was founded to solve a problem in the aviation industry—how to get
high-performance alloy extrusions faster and more efficiently. Based in Chico, California, we stock
a large range of aerospace shapes, including seat tracks, hat sections, and hinge extrusions.

With a 10,000 sq ft facility and an online database of over 40,000 part numbers, we make it easy to
search, cross-reference, and identify the right part. Backed by AS9100 and ISO9001 certifications,

## How to Check Company Status on MCA

The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) portal lets you verify any registered Indian company's
status in seconds — for free.
1. Visit **mca.gov.in** and click *MCA Services*
2. Select *View Company / LLP Master Data*
3. Enter the **CIN** (Corporate Identity Number) or company name
4. Click *Submit* to see the master data
5. Check the **Company Status** field in the results

**Struck Off** — removed from registry, cannot do business

**Dissolved** — company formally closed and deregistered
You can also search any company instantly on **companydetails.in** without visiting MCA directly.

## How to Verify a GST Number

A valid GSTIN (Goods & Services Tax Identification Number) confirms a business is registered to
collect GST. Always verify before making B2B payments.
1. Go to **gst.gov.in** — no login required
2. Click *Search Taxpayer* → *Search by GSTIN / UIN*
3. Enter the **15-character GSTIN** and solve the CAPTCHA
4. Check the **Registration Status** — must show *Active*
5. Verify the **Legal Name** matches your vendor/supplier

How to read a GSTIN
27 AABCU9603R 1 Z 5
■ State code ■ PAN (10) ■ Entity ■ Z ■ Check
A **cancelled** or **suspended** GSTIN means the business cannot charge GST — input tax credit
claims will be disallowed.

## Pvt Ltd vs LLP — Key Differences

Choosing the right business structure affects taxation, liability, compliance burden, and investor
readiness. Here's a quick comparison.

─────────────────┬───────────────────────────┬─────────────────────
Factor           │Pvt Ltd                    │LLP                  
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Liability        │Limited                    │Limited              
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Min. Members     │2 directors, 2 shareholders│2 designated partners
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Tax Rate         │22% (base)                 │30% (flat)           
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Annual Filings   │Higher — ROC + IT + audit  │Lower — MCA + IT     
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Equity / VC      │✔ Allowed                  │✘ Not allowed        
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Foreign Ownership│✔ FDI allowed              │Limited routes       
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Startup India    │✔ Eligible                 │✔ Eligible           
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Cost to Set Up   │₹6,000–₹15,000             │₹3,000–₹8,000        
─────────────────┴───────────────────────────┴─────────────────────
Choose **Pvt Ltd** if you plan to raise funding. Choose **LLP** for professional services firms with
lower compliance needs.

## COOPER PLASTICS: A LEADING CUSTOM PLASTIC MANUFACTURER

###### Established 2023

Cooper Plastics is a custom plastic manufacturer headquartered just outside of Chicago in Whiting,
Indiana. Our company was established in 2023 as a custom manufacturing division of PolyJohn
Enterprises Corporation, a leading, worldwide manufacturer of high-quality portable sanitation
equipment. We specialize in transforming thermoplastic materials into dependable plastic parts and
products.

###### Quality & Consistency

We use state-of-the-art machines and excel at every aspect of the manufacturing process from raw
thermoplastic material to finished product. We only utilize the industry’s best plastic materials
and cutting-edge equipment to transform it to exact specifications. This level of quality control
enables us to manufacture consistent, high-quality plastic products, every time!

###### Experienced Team

Our team possesses decades of experience in the plastics manufacturing sector. We not only employ
knowledgeable machinists who keep our production process running efficiently but also product
designers and engineers who empower us to innovate and provide custom solutions for our customers’
unique needs. The experts at Cooper Plastics are second to none and ensure our custom plastic

## WHAT IS CUSTOM PLASTICS FABRICATION?

Custom plastics fabrication is the process of designing and creating plastic components tailored
specifically to meet the unique requirements of a project. Unlike standard plastic manufacturing,
which produces generic items in bulk, custom plastic manufacturing allows for customization of size,
shape, material, and functionality. This production process ensures that the end product aligns
perfectly with the client’s specifications, whether it’s for industrial use, consumer goods, or
specialized equipment.

At Cooper Plastics, our approach to custom fabrication is to combine the skills of our craftsmen
with high-quality materials and advanced manufacturing technology. We start by reviewing your needs
and the specifications of your project. From there, we collaborate to choose the materials and
manufacturing techniques that will produce the desired results within your budget. Once all the
details are finalized, we’ll get your job scheduled for production. Our experts are committed to
quality and ensure every piece we fabricate not only meets but exceeds your expectations.

## Global Commitment

ENTEK sells lead-acid separators, lithium-ion separators, extruders, and engineering services on six
continents.

We design and build our battery separator lines, extruders, and parts with our in-house engineering,
machining, and fabrication resources. Combining best-in-class equipment with our pursuit of
continuous improvement manufacturing gives our customers the full benefit of over 40 years of
experience in these industries. We believe that our success is possible only if we do our utmost to
make our customers successful. You will see and feel this commitment from the first day you do
business with ENTEK.

## ENTEK Core Values

ENTEK’s DNA is based on a set of Core Values, which drive everything we do.

### Respect

Be honest and honor every person and organization we interact with

### Integrity

Stand behind what we say and act accordingly

### Innovation

Create new opportunities and relentlessly improve

### Commitment

Take initiative, display a “can do” attitude, work together to reach a common goal and celebrate
victories

ENTEK INTERNATIONAL GLOBAL VISION

ENTEK MISSION

Working together and moving the World ahead with ENTEK products in Vehicles, Devices, Homes, and New
Markets. Working together means harnessing the talents of ENTEK’s three divisions and joining our
customers to make great products together. Our vision isn’t limited by geography: we stand ready to
serve customers anywhere on the globe. Our current focus is on energy storage for vehicles,
hand-held consumer electronics, membranes used in clothing, and extrusion systems used to
manufacture the materials that go into a myriad of consumer products. ENTEK maintains an active
research and development effort to develop new products and markets. We will enter new markets where
we can make a positive difference for our customers.

# Setting the Global Standard in Plastics Extrusion

Welcome to Graham Engineering Company – inventors of the Graham Wheel in 1964 and a global leader in
plastics extrusion innovation. For over half a century, we’ve set the benchmark for performance,
precision, and reliability in the industry.

### Engineered for Performance

At Graham Engineering, we deliver more than just machinery. We deliver custom extrusion solutions
designed to meet your exact specifications. Across our product lines, our machines are trusted
around the world for their consistent performance, reliability, and results.

Graham’s innovations produce reliable, replicable parisons and quality single screw extrusion with
the ability to seamlessly integrate downstream equipment. Our clients trust Graham because our
innovative machines – customized to precisely meet their needs – saves them time and money.

### Complete Extrusion Solutions

We serve a wide range of industries with tailored solutions including blow molding, sheet extrusion,
industrial, and medical tubing solutions. Our comprehensive systems, including fully-integrated
downstream equipment, allow our clients to reach new levels of quality and efficiency.

### A Legacy of Quality

For decades, Graham Engineering has earned the trust of clients worldwide through our steadfast
commitment to engineering excellence. We’re proud to unite the strengths of American Kuhne^{®},
Welex^{®}, and Navigator^{®} Controls – blending our heritage of quality with a focus on innovation
to create unrivaled solutions for our customers.

Our dedication doesn’t end at installation. We offer a comprehensive line of OEM spare parts,
precisely engineered to support your equipment long after the sale, reflecting our commitment to
quality and optimized performance throughout the lifetime of your machinery.

## We Invented What's Expected

### The Graham Wheel^{®}

The Graham Wheel revolutionized the plastics extrusion industry by replacing dangling, malformed
parisons with upward moving, perfectly formed, and replicable extrusion providing maximum production
in the minimum footprint. Graham Quick Change™ molds and operator-friendly engineering allow for
single operator mold changes in under 5 minutes. We invented what’s now expected, the industry
standard.

## Navigator^{®}

The Navigator system is Graham’s signature, proprietary computer control system for integrated
process control. The Navigator enables operators to monitor and control functionality. This
intuitive system integrates a 100-point parison programmer with the ability to data for monitoring
and trend tracking. It features user-friendly controls and trend tracking capability. Navigator
Controls, often imitated, never duplicated.

## Medical Extrusion Systems

Focusing on medical tubing, balloon catheters, and other healthcare applications, our medical
extrusion systems combine proven machinery and controls with downstream equipment. Graham
Engineering Corporation is adept at translating your needs for production volume, speed, and
materials into the perfect extrusion system for your brand. Contact a rep to match your needs to the
ideal combination of our proven equipment.

## About Hangzhou Switara Packing Co., Ltd.

Hangzhou Switara Packing Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer specializing in thermoforming
packaging machines and plastic forming automation solutions. Since its establishment, the company
has focused on delivering advanced, reliable, and efficient packaging technologies for industries
such as food, medical, electronics, and consumer goods.

With a strong emphasis on innovation and engineering excellence, Switara has continuously evolved to
meet the growing demands of global packaging markets.

Today, Switara continues to expand its global presence, committed to providing high-performance
thermoforming packaging machinery and becoming a trusted partner for customers seeking efficient and
scalable packaging automation solutions.

[Hangzhou Switara Packing Co. Ltd - Thermoforming Packaging Machine Manufacturer]

## Our Development Journey

From a small workshop to a globally recognized thermoforming packaging machinery manufacturer — our
growth story reflects relentless dedication to engineering excellence.

Founding Stage

### From Workshop to Manufacturer

In its early years, the company started as a small workshop dedicated to basic plastic forming
equipment. Through consistent investment in research and development, Switara gradually expanded its
capabilities, introducing semi-automatic thermoforming machines and improving production precision.

Growth Phase

### Full Automation & Intelligent Systems

As market demand increased, the company transitioned into fully automated thermoforming packaging
systems, integrating modern control technologies and intelligent operation features. This pivotal
shift enabled Switara to serve larger, more demanding industrial clients globally.

Maturity & Scale

### Comprehensive Production System Established

Hangzhou Switara Packing Co., Ltd. established a comprehensive production system supported by
experienced engineers, advanced manufacturing facilities, and strict quality control processes. The
company now offers customized solutions, including vacuum forming, pressure forming, and integrated
packaging lines designed to enhance productivity and reduce operational costs.

Present Day

### Global Expansion & Trusted Partnership

Today, Switara continues to expand its global presence, committed to providing high-performance
thermoforming packaging machinery and becoming a trusted partner for customers seeking efficient and
scalable packaging automation solutions across more than 50 countries worldwide.

## Core Products & Solutions

Switara offers a comprehensive portfolio of thermoforming packaging machinery engineered for
precision, efficiency, and long-term reliability across diverse industrial applications.

### Fully Automatic Thermoforming Packaging Machines

High-speed, fully automated thermoforming systems integrating forming, filling, sealing, and cutting
processes in a single continuous production line. Ideal for large-scale industrial packaging
operations.

Precision-engineered semi-automatic solutions designed for flexible production environments.

## Why Choose Laird Plastics as Your Industrial Plastic Supplier

Since 1970, Laird Plastics has been North America's trusted partner for businesses requiring
high-quality plastic materials and expert fabrication services. As the continent's largest
independent plastic distributor, we combine the personalized service of a local supplier with the
buying power, inventory depth, and technical expertise of a national organization serving aerospace,
medical, manufacturing, construction, and signage industries.

### Unmatched Material Selection

Our 50+ distribution centers maintain one of the industry's largest inventories of plastic sheets,
rods, tubes, and films. From standard materials like acrylic and polycarbonate to specialty
engineering plastics like PEEK, PTFE, and Ultem, we stock materials from the world's leading
manufacturers including Plaskolite, SABIC, Röhm, and Evonik. Every location provides immediate
access to common materials with overnight shipping available for specialized requirements.

### Expert Technical Support

Our material specialists average 15+ years of plastics industry experience and provide expert
guidance on material selection, compliance requirements, and application engineering. We understand
the specific demands of aerospace, medical, food processing, and other regulated industries, helping
you select materials that meet FDA, NSF, UL, ASTM, and other critical certifications. Technical
consultations are complimentary at all locations.

### Custom Fabrication Capabilities

Beyond material distribution, our precision CNC machining centers deliver custom-fabricated
components including laser cutting, routing, thermoforming, plastic welding, and close-tolerance
machining. From prototype quantities to production runs, we provide value-added services that reduce
your production time and costs. Same-day cutting service available on stock materials at most
locations.

### Nationwide Coverage, Local Service

With strategically positioned facilities throughout North America, we deliver the responsiveness of
a local plastic supplier backed by national resources. Most locations offer will-call pickup and
same-day shipping on stock materials, ensuring your projects stay on schedule. Our geographic
coverage includes major manufacturing hubs from coast to coast, providing reliable access to
industrial plastics wherever your business operates.

## Comprehensive Plastic Materials Inventory

From commodity plastics to high-performance engineering polymers, Laird Plastics maintains North
America's most extensive selection of plastic sheets, rods, tubes, and films. Our inventory spans
every application from aerospace components to marine fabrication, architectural glazing to food
processing equipment.

[Clear acrylic and polycarbonate sheets for displays and safety applications]

### Clear & Transparent Plastics

Our acrylic sheets and polycarbonate panels dominate transparent plastic applications. Cast acrylic
offers crystal clarity for museum displays, aquariums, and architectural glazing, while
polycarbonate provides 250 times the impact resistance of glass for machine guards, safety shields,
and bulletproof barriers. Available in clear, tinted, and UV-stabilized formulations from
manufacturers like Plaskolite, SABIC, and Röhm. PVC sheets offer economical transparency with
excellent chemical resistance for industrial applications. [Shop Clear Plastics][79]

[High-performance PEEK, Ultem, and engineering plastic materials]

### Engineering Plastics

High-performance engineering plastics including PEEK, Ultem, Torlon, acetal (Delrin), and nylon
deliver exceptional mechanical properties for demanding applications. PEEK withstands continuous
temperatures to 480°F while maintaining dimensional stability in aerospace and semiconductor
environments. Acetal offers low friction for gears and bearings. PTFE (Teflon) provides chemical
inertness and non-stick properties for chemical processing. These materials meet stringent aerospace
(AS9100), medical (USP Class VI), and industrial specifications. [Shop Engineering Materials][80]

### Who we are

### FROM HUMBLE BEGINNINGS TO WORLD CLASS

Forty years ago, a driven entrepreneur started a film converting and distribution business built on
customer service and quality. From John Parsio, Sr.’s single slitter operation, Multi-Plastics has
become a global leader.

[ About Us ][42]

### What we do

### MANUFACTURER. CONVERTER. DISTRIBUTOR.

With technology-driven product performance, Multi-Plastics has become a leader in plastic film roll
slitting and sheet converting with global reach. With proprietary extrusion lines, we can meet your
film solution needs.

[ Our Capabilities ][43]

### Who we serve

### OUR MARKETS & FILM SOLUTION APPLICATIONS

We provide film application solutions from short-run to full scale across the envelope, tag & label,
folding carton, sheet-fed and specialty markets.

## OUR SERVICES + CAPABILITIES

### Multi-Plastics is a full-service, vertically integrated company. From polymerization and
### extrusion, to roll slitting and sheet converting, to global distribution... we've got you
### covered.

[
][58]

### Manufacturing

Multi-Plastics Extrusions, acquired in 2010, offers expert custom extruded OPS, PET, and PP films
for various applications. With ten extrusion lines and our Hazleton, PA polymerization facility,
plus an in-house R&D lab, we have the technical expertise to stay at the forefront of film extrusion
while meeting market cost demands.
* [ Learn more about Sheet & Film Extrusion ][59]

[
][60]

### Converting

Multi-Plastics produces over three million pounds of plastic films monthly from six North American
and one European facility. With over twenty-five slitting assets worldwide, we can handle any scale,
from a single roll to truckload quantities. You can trust our team to meet your needs.
* [ Learn more about Custom Roll Slitting ][61]
* [ Learn more about Sheet Converting ][62]

[
][63]

### Lab Services & Capabilities

Since 1979, Multi-Plastics has partnered with leading manufacturers to distribute custom plastic
films from seven global facilities. We offer tailored solutions and precision slitting and sheeting
to meet market demands. Converting over 3 million pounds of films monthly, with more than 75%
shipping within 3 days, we provide efficient distribution solutions for your unique needs.
* [ Learn more about our Lab Services & Capabilities ][64]

[
][65]

### Global Distribution

Our global reach includes six North American converting facilities (each over 45,000 sq. ft.), one
converting and distribution facility in England, and three international warehouse partnerships.
* [ Learn more about Global Distribution ][66]

QForm UK: design and simulation solutions for metal forming industries
Professional engineering software for design, simulation, analysis and optimization of metal
deformation processes
[-]
Boost your production, reduce cost, extend your product range — QForm it!

QForm UK is a universal program trusted and widely used by researchers, scientists, industrial
engineers, and technical specialists. By using accurate numerical simulation, users can predict
material flow, final geometry, defects, loads, and process limits at early design stages. This
significantly reduces the need for costly physical trials, shortens development time, improves
product quality, and increases tool life. Various metal products developed with the help of QForm UK
are now used in components and systems that form an integral part of our everyday life.

Technology validation and finalization
Increasing tool life
Predicting defects and structural properties
Quick generation of reports in visual or tables form
Reducing design time
Equipment selection
Design and simulation with a flexible API and machine learning features

QForm UK is designed for cold, warm, and hot die forging, open-die forging, rolling, profile
extrusion, and other specific metal forming processes. The software can be extended with a variety
of specialized modules, including microstructure prediction, heat treatment simulation, and
user-defined subroutines. A lot of advanced capabilities are implemented through a flexible API,
allowing users to customize the program for specific technological tasks and research needs.

# Your Partner for Plastic Solutions

## Providing custom solutions with high quality plastic components since 1987.

From custom extrusions, standard extrusions and injection molded components, to CNC machining,
fabrication and assembly, we are your one-stop shop when it comes to plastics.


[ONLINE CATALOG][76]                                               [REQUEST A QUOTE][77]

**READY TO GET STARTED?**

** **Contact us now to discuss your custom plastic needs with one of our pros.

[ CONTACT US ][78]

Founded in 1987 and now operating as part of Grupo Verzatec, SeaGate Plastics provides customers
with reliable production, engineering support, and quick turnaround times. With over 85,000 square
feet of manufacturing space across Ohio and Michigan, the company continues to serve businesses that
rely on consistent quality and dependable service.

As one of the established plastic extrusion companies in North America, SeaGate Plastics has built
its name on precision manufacturing and long-term customer relationships. Every project is managed
by a team that understands the specific needs of industrial, packaging, construction, and OEM
customers.

## Capabilities Overview

SeaGate Plastics specializes in a wide range of fabrication services. This includes custom and
standard plastic extrusion, injection molded plastics, and CNC machining of plastic sheet goods.
With in-house tooling, engineering design, and material selection support, customers can bring their
part concepts to life without juggling multiple vendors.

### Stock Plastic Extrusions

[SeaGate Plastics supplies a broad range of in-stock profiles][79], including U-channels, tubing,
flippers, angles, and snap-on components. Choosing from our existing dies reduces lead times and
tooling costs. As one of the trusted plastic extrusion companies in the U.S., we maintain active
inventory and offer just-in-time shipping to support your production schedule.

[READ MORE][80]

### Custom Plastic Extrusions

We work closely with customers to design and produce [custom extrusions][81] that meet exact
specifications. From material selection to tooling, our in-house team manages every step. As
experienced plastic extrusion manufacturers, we deliver consistent results across industries like
packaging, construction, and OEM manufacturing.

[READ MORE][82]

### Plastic CNC Machining & Fabrication (and Injection Molding)

SeaGate Plastics offers [CNC routing and machining][83] for plastic sheet goods up to 3 inches
thick. We cut, drill, and shape parts to spec, and can add services like tape application and
assembly. Combined with our injection molded plastics production, we provide a full range of plastic
part solutions—all under one roof.

## **What are Miracle sheets?**

[[What is Miracle Sheets]][7]

Experience the future of sleep with Miracle Sheets, the innovative bedding that combines luxury,
hygiene, and durability. Crafted from premium Supima Cotton, these sheets are infused with naturally
antibacterial silver, ensuring a cleaner, healthier sleep environment.

Superior Hygiene: Silver's powerful antimicrobial properties effectively combat bacteria and germs,

luxurious and hypoallergenic sleeping experience.

OEKO-TEX Certified: Rest assured that our sheets are free from harmful chemicals, making them ideal

## **How Does Miracle sheets Works?**

Miracle Sheets use the natural properties of silver to keep your sheets cleaner and fresher for
longer. Silver has been known to kill bacteria for a long time. When bacteria touch the silver in
the sheets, the silver stops the bacteria from growing and spreading. This means there are fewer
germs on your sheets, which helps prevent bad smells and skin problems.

Additionally, the sheets are composed of premium cotton, which aids in temperature regulation. You
stay warm in the winter and cool in the summer because this cotton absorbs moisture and improves air
flow. This, along with the silver, improves the hygienic and comfort of your bed.

In Short, Miracle Sheets use silver to eradicate bacteria and maintain the cleanliness of the
sheets. The silver is dispersed throughout the fabric to prolong the freshness and health of your
bed. The fabric with silver infusion is long-lasting and robust. The antibacterial qualities hold
true even after frequent washing and use.

# Thermal Barriers

**Western Extrusions** also provides pour and debridge capabilities. This process is used in the
manufacture of **aluminum** thermal barrier windows and doors. We break the continuity of the
framing profiles using a low conductivity polyurethane resin which is poured into an **extrusion**
cavity and when hardened the base of the cavity is debridged, resulting in a composite extrusion
which performs as a single structural entity. The resultant thermal bridge separating the interior
and exterior of the frame has excellent energy conservation properties and will substantially reduce
condensation or frost formation.

## What We Do

Aircraft Extrusion Company was founded to solve a problem in the aviation industry—how to get
high-performance alloy extrusions faster and more efficiently. Based in Chico, California, we stock
a large range of aerospace shapes, including seat tracks, hat sections, and hinge extrusions.

With a 10,000 sq ft facility and an online database of over 40,000 part numbers, we make it easy to

## How to Check Company Status on MCA

The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) portal lets you verify any registered Indian company's
status in seconds — for free.
1. Visit **mca.gov.in** and click *MCA Services*
2. Select *View Company / LLP Master Data*
3. Enter the **CIN** (Corporate Identity Number) or company name
4. Click *Submit* to see the master data
5. Check the **Company Status** field in the results

**Active** — company is in good standing and filing compliances
**Struck Off** — removed from registry, cannot do business
**Under Liquidation** — winding-up proceedings ongoing
**Dissolved** — company formally closed and deregistered
You can also search any company instantly on **companydetails.in** without visiting MCA directly.

## How to Check Company Status on MCA

The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) portal lets you verify any registered Indian company's
status in seconds — for free.
1. Visit **mca.gov.in** and click *MCA Services*
2. Select *View Company / LLP Master Data*
3. Enter the **CIN** (Corporate Identity Number) or company name
4. Click *Submit* to see the master data
5. Check the **Company Status** field in the results

**Active** — company is in good standing and filing compliances
**Struck Off** — removed from registry, cannot do business
**Under Liquidation** — winding-up proceedings ongoing
**Dissolved** — company formally closed and deregistered
You can also search any company instantly on **companydetails.in** without visiting MCA directly.

## How to Verify a GST Number

A valid GSTIN (Goods & Services Tax Identification Number) confirms a business is registered to
collect GST. Always verify before making B2B payments.
1. Go to **gst.gov.in** — no login required
2. Click *Search Taxpayer* → *Search by GSTIN / UIN*
3. Enter the **15-character GSTIN** and solve the CAPTCHA
4. Check the **Registration Status** — must show *Active*
5. Verify the **Legal Name** matches your vendor/supplier

How to read a GSTIN
27 AABCU9603R 1 Z 5
■ State code ■ PAN (10) ■ Entity ■ Z ■ Check
A **cancelled** or **suspended** GSTIN means the business cannot charge GST — input tax credit
claims will be disallowed.

[Sheet Extrusion]

## [Sheet Extrusion][35]

Raw plastic material (resin) is processed into flat sheets that can be used in other plastic
manufacturing processes.

[Thermoforming]

## [Thermoforming][36]

Heat and pressure are used to force plastic sheets into a mold and transform them into the end
product.

[Rotational Molding]

## [Rotational Molding][37]

In this process, also known as rotomolding, the mold is rotated vertically and horizontally in an
oven to produce hollow plastic products.

[Injection Molding]

## [Injection Molding][38]

Molten plastic is injected into the mold to produce durable plastic products and minimize scrap
material.

## [Blow Molding][39]

Compressed air is blown into a plastic tube (parison/preform) within the mold to produce hollow
plastic parts and products.

[Value Added Services]

## [Structural Foam Injection Molding][40]

This process combines traditional injection molding with a foaming agent to create parts with a
foamed core and solid outer skin that are lightweight but durable.

## WHAT IS CUSTOM PLASTICS FABRICATION?

Custom plastics fabrication is the process of designing and creating plastic components tailored
specifically to meet the unique requirements of a project. Unlike standard plastic manufacturing,
which produces generic items in bulk, custom plastic manufacturing allows for customization of size,
shape, material, and functionality. This production process ensures that the end product aligns
perfectly with the client’s specifications, whether it’s for industrial use, consumer goods, or
specialized equipment.

At Cooper Plastics, our approach to custom fabrication is to combine the skills of our craftsmen
with high-quality materials and advanced manufacturing technology. We start by reviewing your needs
and the specifications of your project. From there, we collaborate to choose the materials and
manufacturing techniques that will produce the desired results within your budget. Once all the
details are finalized, we’ll get your job scheduled for production. Our experts are committed to
quality and ensure every piece we fabricate not only meets but exceeds your expectations.

## Global Commitment

ENTEK sells lead-acid separators, lithium-ion separators, extruders, and engineering services on six
continents.

We design and build our battery separator lines, extruders, and parts with our in-house engineering,
machining, and fabrication resources. Combining best-in-class equipment with our pursuit of
continuous improvement manufacturing gives our customers the full benefit of over 40 years of
experience in these industries. We believe that our success is possible only if we do our utmost to
make our customers successful. You will see and feel this commitment from the first day you do
business with ENTEK.

## ENTEK Core Values

ENTEK’s DNA is based on a set of Core Values, which drive everything we do.

### Respect

Be honest and honor every person and organization we interact with

### Integrity

Stand behind what we say and act accordingly

### Innovation

Create new opportunities and relentlessly improve

### Commitment

Take initiative, display a “can do” attitude, work together to reach a common goal and celebrate
victories

ENTEK INTERNATIONAL GLOBAL VISION

ENTEK MISSION

Working together and moving the World ahead with ENTEK products in Vehicles, Devices, Homes, and New
Markets. Working together means harnessing the talents of ENTEK’s three divisions and joining our
customers to make great products together. Our vision isn’t limited by geography: we stand ready to
serve customers anywhere on the globe. Our current focus is on energy storage for vehicles,
hand-held consumer electronics, membranes used in clothing, and extrusion systems used to
manufacture the materials that go into a myriad of consumer products. ENTEK maintains an active
research and development effort to develop new products and markets. We will enter new markets where
we can make a positive difference for our customers.

# Setting the Global Standard in Plastics Extrusion

Welcome to Graham Engineering Company – inventors of the Graham Wheel in 1964 and a global leader in
plastics extrusion innovation. For over half a century, we’ve set the benchmark for performance,
precision, and reliability in the industry.

### Engineered for Performance

At Graham Engineering, we deliver more than just machinery. We deliver custom extrusion solutions
designed to meet your exact specifications. Across our product lines, our machines are trusted
around the world for their consistent performance, reliability, and results.

Graham’s innovations produce reliable, replicable parisons and quality single screw extrusion with
the ability to seamlessly integrate downstream equipment. Our clients trust Graham because our
innovative machines – customized to precisely meet their needs – saves them time and money.

### Complete Extrusion Solutions

We serve a wide range of industries with tailored solutions including blow molding, sheet extrusion,
industrial, and medical tubing solutions. Our comprehensive systems, including fully-integrated
downstream equipment, allow our clients to reach new levels of quality and efficiency.

### A Legacy of Quality

For decades, Graham Engineering has earned the trust of clients worldwide through our steadfast
commitment to engineering excellence. We’re proud to unite the strengths of American Kuhne^{®},
Welex^{®}, and Navigator^{®} Controls – blending our heritage of quality with a focus on innovation
to create unrivaled solutions for our customers.

Our dedication doesn’t end at installation. We offer a comprehensive line of OEM spare parts,
precisely engineered to support your equipment long after the sale, reflecting our commitment to
quality and optimized performance throughout the lifetime of your machinery.

## We Invented What's Expected

### The Graham Wheel^{®}

The Graham Wheel revolutionized the plastics extrusion industry by replacing dangling, malformed
parisons with upward moving, perfectly formed, and replicable extrusion providing maximum production
in the minimum footprint. Graham Quick Change™ molds and operator-friendly engineering allow for
single operator mold changes in under 5 minutes. We invented what’s now expected, the industry
standard.

## Navigator^{®}

The Navigator system is Graham’s signature, proprietary computer control system for integrated
process control. The Navigator enables operators to monitor and control functionality. This
intuitive system integrates a 100-point parison programmer with the ability to data for monitoring
and trend tracking. It features user-friendly controls and trend tracking capability. Navigator
Controls, often imitated, never duplicated.

extrusion systems combine proven machinery and controls with downstream equipment. Graham
Engineering Corporation is adept at translating your needs for production volume, speed, and
materials into the perfect extrusion system for your brand. Contact a rep to match your needs to the

## About Hangzhou Switara Packing Co., Ltd.

Hangzhou Switara Packing Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer specializing in thermoforming
packaging machines and plastic forming automation solutions. Since its establishment, the company
has focused on delivering advanced, reliable, and efficient packaging technologies for industries
such as food, medical, electronics, and consumer goods.

With a strong emphasis on innovation and engineering excellence, Switara has continuously evolved to
meet the growing demands of global packaging markets.

Today, Switara continues to expand its global presence, committed to providing high-performance
thermoforming packaging machinery and becoming a trusted partner for customers seeking efficient and
scalable packaging automation solutions.

## Our Development Journey

From a small workshop to a globally recognized thermoforming packaging machinery manufacturer — our
growth story reflects relentless dedication to engineering excellence.

Founding Stage

### From Workshop to Manufacturer

In its early years, the company started as a small workshop dedicated to basic plastic forming
equipment. Through consistent investment in research and development, Switara gradually expanded its
capabilities, introducing semi-automatic thermoforming machines and improving production precision.

Growth Phase

### Full Automation & Intelligent Systems

As market demand increased, the company transitioned into fully automated thermoforming packaging
systems, integrating modern control technologies and intelligent operation features. This pivotal
shift enabled Switara to serve larger, more demanding industrial clients globally.

Maturity & Scale

### Comprehensive Production System Established

Hangzhou Switara Packing Co., Ltd. established a comprehensive production system supported by
experienced engineers, advanced manufacturing facilities, and strict quality control processes. The
company now offers customized solutions, including vacuum forming, pressure forming, and integrated
packaging lines designed to enhance productivity and reduce operational costs.

Present Day

### Global Expansion & Trusted Partnership

Today, Switara continues to expand its global presence, committed to providing high-performance
thermoforming packaging machinery and becoming a trusted partner for customers seeking efficient and
scalable packaging automation solutions across more than 50 countries worldwide.

* About us

United Integration for Metal Extrusion and Coating **(Integrated Extrusion©) **is a multi-national
Shareholding Company established in 1996.  Specializing in Aluminum Extrusions and Metal Industries.

**Integrated Extrusion©** has become a leading manufacturer and one of the largest in extrusion
sector.  Providing high capacity, technical support, engineering and high-end quality products.  It
is a cutting-edge organization with a combination of highly skilled personnel, pioneering in
aluminum extrusions, backed-up by advance technologies.

With its multi productions and servicing facilities located in Kuwait, Qatar and Technical & Sales
facilities in Bahrain and Italy.  The Company is capable to provide from simple architectural
section to large-scale, complex shape industrial profiles.

Our products are widely used in diverse segments, ranging from construction to consumer durables and
other industrial applications.  We are keeping abreast of the latest technology advances, to cope up
in all application segments as well as the changing nature of consumer needs.  We also pay high
attention to secure a continuous research and development that enable us to offer quality and
durable products to meet the exact end user requirements.

We aim  to meet the Optimal Customer’s Satisfaction, building and strengthening their trust.

With continuous expansion and incessant additions of new products**, Integrated Extrusion©** is an
Ideal Partner to Success.

## Comprehensive Plastic Materials Inventory

From commodity plastics to high-performance engineering polymers, Laird Plastics maintains North
America's most extensive selection of plastic sheets, rods, tubes, and films. Our inventory spans
every application from aerospace components to marine fabrication, architectural glazing to food
processing equipment.

### Clear & Transparent Plastics

Our acrylic sheets and polycarbonate panels dominate transparent plastic applications. Cast acrylic
offers crystal clarity for museum displays, aquariums, and architectural glazing, while
polycarbonate provides 250 times the impact resistance of glass for machine guards, safety shields,
and bulletproof barriers. Available in clear, tinted, and UV-stabilized formulations from
manufacturers like Plaskolite, SABIC, and Röhm. PVC sheets offer economical transparency with
excellent chemical resistance for industrial applications. [Shop Clear Plastics][79]

[High-performance PEEK, Ultem, and engineering plastic materials]

### Engineering Plastics

High-performance engineering plastics including PEEK, Ultem, Torlon, acetal (Delrin), and nylon
deliver exceptional mechanical properties for demanding applications. PEEK withstands continuous
temperatures to 480°F while maintaining dimensional stability in aerospace and semiconductor
environments. Acetal offers low friction for gears and bearings. PTFE (Teflon) provides chemical
inertness and non-stick properties for chemical processing. These materials meet stringent aerospace
(AS9100), medical (USP Class VI), and industrial specifications. [Shop Engineering Materials][80]

### Who we are

### FROM HUMBLE BEGINNINGS TO WORLD CLASS

Forty years ago, a driven entrepreneur started a film converting and distribution business built on
customer service and quality. From John Parsio, Sr.’s single slitter operation, Multi-Plastics has
become a global leader.

[ About Us ][42]

### What we do

### MANUFACTURER. CONVERTER. DISTRIBUTOR.

With technology-driven product performance, Multi-Plastics has become a leader in plastic film roll
slitting and sheet converting with global reach. With proprietary extrusion lines, we can meet your
film solution needs.

[ Our Capabilities ][43]

### Who we serve

### OUR MARKETS & FILM SOLUTION APPLICATIONS

We provide film application solutions from short-run to full scale across the envelope, tag & label,
folding carton, sheet-fed and specialty markets.

## OUR SERVICES + CAPABILITIES

### Multi-Plastics is a full-service, vertically integrated company. From polymerization and
### extrusion, to roll slitting and sheet converting, to global distribution... we've got you
### covered.

[
][58]

### Manufacturing

Multi-Plastics Extrusions, acquired in 2010, offers expert custom extruded OPS, PET, and PP films
for various applications. With ten extrusion lines and our Hazleton, PA polymerization facility,
plus an in-house R&D lab, we have the technical expertise to stay at the forefront of film extrusion
while meeting market cost demands.
* [ Learn more about Sheet & Film Extrusion ][59]

[
][60]

### Converting

Multi-Plastics produces over three million pounds of plastic films monthly from six North American
and one European facility. With over twenty-five slitting assets worldwide, we can handle any scale,
from a single roll to truckload quantities. You can trust our team to meet your needs.
* [ Learn more about Custom Roll Slitting ][61]
* [ Learn more about Sheet Converting ][62]

[
][63]

### Lab Services & Capabilities

Since 1979, Multi-Plastics has partnered with leading manufacturers to distribute custom plastic
films from seven global facilities. We offer tailored solutions and precision slitting and sheeting
to meet market demands. Converting over 3 million pounds of films monthly, with more than 75%
shipping within 3 days, we provide efficient distribution solutions for your unique needs.
* [ Learn more about our Lab Services & Capabilities ][64]

[
][65]

### Global Distribution

Our global reach includes six North American converting facilities (each over 45,000 sq. ft.), one
converting and distribution facility in England, and three international warehouse partnerships.
* [ Learn more about Global Distribution ][66]

Our PVC pipes, sheets, vinyl fences, wall panels, ceiling panels,conduits and marble sheets meet
international quality standards and are exported to clients worldwide. We provide OEM services and
custom solutions to fit your project needs.

Weather-resistant and decorative PVC vinyl fences suitable for residential and commercial use. Easy
to install and maintain, these fences provide long-lasting beauty and functionality for outdoor
spaces.

durable, and easy to clean, they enhance interior aesthetics while providing protection and
insulation.

High-strength PVC pipes for plumbing, construction, and industrial applications. Available in
various diameters and lengths, our PVC pipes are durable, corrosion-resistant, and ideal for global
buyers seeking reliable supply.

Lightweight and durable PVC ceiling panels designed for commercial and residential interiors.
Resistant to moisture and corrosion, they offer a stylish, low-maintenance solution for ceilings.

Durable PVC sheets for signage, packaging, and industrial fabrication. Our sheets come in multiple
thicknesses and sizes, offering excellent flexibility and chemical resistance for diverse
applications.

Reliable PVC conduit solutions for electrical wiring and industrial applications. Our conduits are
corrosion-resistant, flame-retardant, and designed to meet international standards for safety and
durability.

significantly reduces the need for costly physical trials, shortens development time, improves
product quality, and increases tool life. Various metal products developed with the help of QForm UK
are now used in components and systems that form an integral part of our everyday life.

results with real production data has been consistently confirmed.

all features of the program as well as many interesting examples, tutorials, and theoretical basics
of metal forming processes simulation in QForm UK written in an easy-to-understand style.

35+ years of expertise in metal forming simulation software

QForm Group has more than 35 years of experience in software development. Our employees have M.S.
and Ph.D degrees in the metal forming field. The software works in different languages and is widely
used in more than 50 countries around the world by industrial plants as well as leading universities
and research centers. We work to ensure that all our developed software has the best user-friendly
interface and the highest accuracy of calculations. QForm UK users have confidence in the high

## Providing custom solutions with high quality plastic components since 1987.

From custom extrusions, standard extrusions and injection molded components, to CNC machining,
fabrication and assembly, we are your one-stop shop when it comes to plastics.

with reliable production, engineering support, and quick turnaround times. With over 85,000 square
feet of manufacturing space across Ohio and Michigan, the company continues to serve businesses that
rely on consistent quality and dependable service.

standard plastic extrusion, injection molded plastics, and CNC machining of plastic sheet goods.

part concepts to life without juggling multiple vendors.

flippers, angles, and snap-on components. Choosing from our existing dies reduces lead times and
tooling costs. As one of the trusted plastic extrusion companies in the U.S., we maintain active
inventory and offer just-in-time shipping to support your production schedule.

We work closely with customers to design and produce [custom extrusions][81] that meet exact

packaging, construction, and OEM manufacturing.

**Western Extrusions** also provides pour and debridge capabilities. This process is used in the
manufacture of **aluminum** thermal barrier windows and doors. We break the continuity of the

cavity and when hardened the base of the cavity is debridged, resulting in a composite extrusion
which performs as a single structural entity. The resultant thermal bridge separating the interior
and exterior of the frame has excellent energy conservation properties and will substantially reduce
condensation or frost formation.
